title: The Velvet Keyword Cipher
description: 🔐 Encrypted USB Drive containing a keyword substitution cipher using the keyword 'VELVET'.
question: Decrypt the message encoded with key 'VELVET' (Cipher Alphabet: V E L T A B C D F G H I J K M N O P Q R S U W X Y Z): 'TBX TFEP HQ WBLTH'
hints: A keyword cipher removes duplicate letters from the keyword and appends remaining alphabet letters.
Keyword VELVET gives unique key header V-E-L-T.
Map each cipher letter back to its standard A-Z counterpart to reveal 'THE DEED IS VALID'.
solution: Reversing the keyword substitution mapping reveals the underlying secret phrase: 'THE DEED IS VALID'.
